effects.name: Orbit
effects.prompt: A man sits at a desk in a bright home office, the camera makes one smooth 180 degree orbit around him at chest height, soft key light, shallow depth of field.

effects.name: Chat Takeover
effects.prompt: A man talks to camera, then a chat-message bubble panel slides up and covers the frame, the camera holds steady, clean modern lighting.

effects.name: Frame Escape
effects.prompt: A man pushes outward against the edge of the frame and breaks out of it, the camera pulls back slightly, crisp studio lighting.

effects.name: Snap Zoom
effects.prompt: A man talks to camera, then a fast snap zoom punches into his face on a beat, static camera otherwise, warm lighting.

effects.name: Checklist Pop
effects.prompt: A man gestures and a checklist card pops onto the frame with items ticking off one by one, static camera, bright even lighting.

effects.name: Headline Storm
effects.prompt: Large bold headline words fly in from different directions and stack around a man talking to camera, static wide shot, high-contrast lighting.

effects.name: Zoom Portal
effects.prompt: A man stands in front of a circular portal that zooms the camera through into a new scene, smooth push-in, cinematic lighting.

effects.name: Growth Curve
effects.prompt: A man points to a rising line chart that draws itself across the frame behind him, static camera, clean office lighting.

effects.name: Studio Reveal
effects.prompt: The shot starts on a dark studio, lights flicker on and the camera pulls back to reveal a man at a desk, slow dolly out, dramatic key light.

effects.name: B-roll Overlay
effects.prompt: A man talks to camera while a small b-roll clip of a laptop screen overlays the lower corner of the frame, static camera, natural light.

effects.name: Paper Cutout
effects.prompt: A man is rendered as a layered paper cutout that slides apart in parallax as the camera moves, flat colors, soft shadows.

effects.name: Dolly Zoom
effects.prompt: The camera dollies back while zooming in on a man's face, creating a vertigo-style background stretch, dramatic lighting.

effects.name: Magazine Cover
effects.prompt: A man is framed like a magazine cover with a bold masthead above him, static camera, glossy editorial lighting.

effects.name: Liquid Glass
effects.prompt: A man is seen through a rippling liquid glass panel that warps and refracts as the camera drifts slowly, soft highlights.

effects.name: Zoom Through Cut
effects.prompt: The camera zooms through a man's glasses into a second scene, a seamless match cut, shallow depth of field.

effects.name: Green Screen
effects.prompt: A man stands in front of a green screen that is replaced by a city skyline backdrop, static camera, even flat lighting.

effects.name: Frame Break
effects.prompt: A man's head breaks through the top edge of the frame and out of the border, the camera holds steady, bright studio lighting.

effects.name: Digital Zoom
effects.prompt: A man talks to camera and the frame digitally zooms into a cropped sub-frame with a HUD-style overlay, clean tech aesthetic.

effects.name: Phone Mockup
effects.prompt: A man holds up a phone whose screen lifts out into a floating 3D phone mockup in the frame, static camera, soft studio lighting.

effects.name: Checklist
effects.prompt: A man talks to camera while a full checklist slides in from the side with each item checking off in turn, static camera, bright lighting.
